info.title: Unified Memory
info.author: desonect
info.description: Use multiple WFS USB storage drives simultaneously on Wii U.
info.details:
A 100% RAM-only Aroma (WUPS) plugin that lets you use multiple WFS USB storage devices at the same time on Nintendo Wii U (e.g., Internal NAND + SDUSB + an external USB drive).

Features:
- Bypasses the Wii U Menu multi-USB prompt (hooks nn::spm::GetStorageList strictly on Wii U Menu Title IDs).
- Preserves System Settings -> Data Management so all connected storage drives remain visible.
- Adds a WUPS Config Menu (L + Down + Minus -> Unified Memory) to choose USB 1 or USB 2 as the install target for title installers.
- Zero NAND or kernel modifications; each drive remains an independent WFS volume.
